name: qa-test-management
description: Test case management for TestRail, Xray, Zephyr Scale, Allure TestOps and Qase: case authoring, ISO 29119-3 case anatomy, and traceability matrices. Agents (test-case-quality-critic, tcm-migration-agent) audit test cases against the review rubric and migrate cases between tools. Covers pre-execution case management; result sync lives in qa-test-reporting.
